title: Canonical sheaf-slice restriction of cochain complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $R$ a ring sheaf and $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ its module category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $D$ be a coherent Cech image model [def-sfb-coherent-cech-image-model]. For a sheaf of sets $A$, write $R_A$ for the element-site ring and $j_A^*$ for canonical module restriction [def-sfb-element-site-localization]. Define the restriction functor on integer-indexed cochain complexes by $(j_A^*I)^q=j_A^*(I^q)$, differential $j_A^*(d_I)$ and chain maps $j_A^*(t^q)$. Additivity of $j_A^*$ is obtained from its adjunction in $D$ and preservation of binary biproducts. This is the ordinary mapHomologicalComplex construction, with the actual sectionwise restriction in every degree.
